summary.headline: 6 of 18 buyer-intent queries are unanswerable from the AI-reachable corpus

findings.title: 2 of 12 page(s): heading hierarchy issue(s) -- no <h1> found
findings.evidence: https://www.allbirds.com/pages/help: heading sequence: [4]; issues: ['no <h1> found']; https://www.allbirds.com/products/anytime-ankle-sock-blizzard-sienna-blush: heading sequence: [1, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3]; issues: ["heading level skip: jumped to h3 after h1 (text: 'Notify me when back in stock')"]

verification.method: re-fetched https://www.allbirds.com/pages/help with a different UA (GPTBot); status was None, now 200

findings.impact_mechanism: Extraction/chunking pipelines commonly use heading structure to infer a document's outline and segment content. An ambiguous or broken outline risks content getting attributed to the wrong section, or chunk boundaries landing in the wrong place -- invisible to a human skimming the styled page, very visible to anything parsing the DOM structure.

suggested_action.summary: Use exactly one <h1> per page and avoid heading-level skips.
implementation: Restructure headings to a single h1 with no level skips
suggested_action.verification_step: curl -s https://www.allbirds.com/pages/help | grep -oE '<h[1-6]' -- should start with h1 and never skip a level

findings.title: 6 of 18 buyer-intent queries are unanswerable from the AI-reachable corpus
findings.evidence: [pricing] 'How much does Allbirds cost?' -> ungrounded; [comparison] 'How does Allbirds compare to competitors?' -> ungrounded; [trust] 'Is Allbirds a legitimate company?' -> ungrounded; [trust] 'What do customers say about Allbirds?' -> ungrounded; [trust] 'Are there reviews of Allbirds?' -> ungrounded; [contact] 'Where is Allbirds located?' -> ungrounded

verification.method: re-fetched https://www.allbirds.com/ with a different UA (GPTBot); status was None, now 200

findings.impact_mechanism: Even where a page nominally contains this information somewhere on the site, it isn't retrievable the way an assistant's own retrieval pipeline would actually find it -- the query's own terms don't surface a chunk that grounds an answer. This is the direct, outcome-anchored metric that determines answer visibility, not an intermediate proxy.
affected_queries: How does Allbirds compare to competitors?
What do customers say about Allbirds?

suggested_action.summary: Add direct, front-loaded answers to buyer-intent questions in the site's own language, not just marketing narrative.
implementation: Review the affected_queries list and add a page or section that states each answer directly
Use the buyer's own phrasing, not just internal terminology
suggested_action.verification_step: Re-run the audit after publishing the change and confirm the query's outcome improves

findings.title: 5 buyer-intent queries can only be answered by combining facts from different pages
findings.evidence: [pricing] "What is the price of Allbirds's product?"; [comparison] 'What makes Allbirds different from other product options?'; [comparison] 'Is Allbirds better than alternatives?'; [capability] 'What features does Allbirds offer?'; [capability] "What are the specifications of Allbirds's product?"

verification.method: re-fetched https://www.allbirds.com/ with a different UA (GPTBot); status was None, now 200

findings.impact_mechanism: The answer exists in the corpus but only by combining facts from two or more distinct pages -- e.g. one page's specification plus another page's price. Real retrieval pipelines rarely perform this cross-page join at query time, so a PARTIAL outcome here is more fragile than a same-page multi-chunk assembly.
affected_queries: What is the price of Allbirds's product?
What makes Allbirds different from other product options?
What are the specifications of Allbirds's product?

suggested_action.summary: Co-locate the related facts on a single page rather than relying on a reader (or retriever) to combine two pages.
implementation: Summarize the combined fact (e.g. spec + price together) on at least one page
suggested_action.verification_step: Re-run the audit and confirm the query now resolves from a single page

findings.title: 6 of 12 citable answers sit in the back half of their page
findings.evidence: [identity] 'What is Allbirds?' -> https://www.allbirds.com/pages/help (70% into the page); [identity] 'What does Allbirds do?' -> https://www.allbirds.com/pages/help (70% into the page); [identity] 'Tell me about Allbirds' -> https://www.allbirds.com/pages/help (70% into the page); [pricing] "What is the price of Allbirds's product?" -> https://www.allbirds.com/pages/help (70% into the page); [capability] "What can Allbirds's product do?" -> https://www.allbirds.com/pages/help (70% into the page)

verification.method: re-fetched https://www.allbirds.com/pages/help with a different UA (GPTBot); status was None, now 200

findings.impact_mechanism: An AI-referred visitor arrives deep-linked and mid-task, already given a partial answer by the assistant -- they scan to confirm it, not to read the page fresh. An answer buried past the page's own midpoint asks that visitor to re-find what they were already told, which is exactly the friction a search visitor (who chose to click in cold) tolerates but an AI-referred one doesn't.
affected_queries: What is the price of Allbirds's product?
What are the specifications of Allbirds's product?

suggested_action.summary: Move the cited answer, or a direct one-line restatement of it, higher in the page's main content.
implementation: Lead the relevant section with the direct answer before any narrative framing
suggested_action.verification_step: Re-run the audit and confirm the query's top_chunk_position_ratio drops

findings.title: 2 of 3 page(s): a cold arrival can't tell what this is without the nav
findings.evidence: https://www.allbirds.com/pages/help: 'Allbirds' appears on the page but not in its first 500 characters; https://www.allbirds.com/products/anytime-ankle-sock-blizzard-sienna-blush: 'Allbirds' appears on the page but not in its first 500 characters

verification.method: re-fetched https://www.allbirds.com/pages/help with a different UA (GPTBot); status was None, now 200

findings.impact_mechanism: An AI-referred visitor lands on this exact page, never the homepage, with zero prior context about the brand -- they don't see the nav or logo as onboarding, because they don't browse to get here. If the page's own main content never names the brand near the top, a cold arrival has nothing on the page itself confirming what company this is or that the assistant's citation landed somewhere legitimate.

suggested_action.summary: Name the brand explicitly in the page's opening content, not just in the nav/logo.
implementation: Add a one-line brand-identifying sentence near the top of the main content
suggested_action.verification_step: Re-run the audit and confirm this page no longer appears in ENGAGE-002

findings.title: 3 of 3 citable page(s) carry a consent/gate overlay that may block first meaningful paint
findings.evidence: https://www.allbirds.com/pages/design-system: 'onetrust' signature present; https://www.allbirds.com/pages/help: 'onetrust' signature present; https://www.allbirds.com/products/anytime-ankle-sock-blizzard-sienna-blush: 'onetrust' signature present

verification.method: re-fetched https://www.allbirds.com/pages/design-system with a different UA (GPTBot); status was None, now 200

findings.impact_mechanism: An AI-referred visitor arrives already mid-task expecting to confirm a specific answer. A consent wall, age gate, or modal between them and the page's own content adds friction a search visitor (who browsed in cold) tolerates but an already-informed visitor doesn't -- and if it blocks first paint, it can hide the very answer the assistant cited.

suggested_action.summary: Make consent/gate overlays non-blocking: render page content first, or default to a reasonable choice instead of gating first paint.
implementation: Defer the overlay's own script so it doesn't block content rendering
Default to the most restrictive consent choice rather than blocking until an explicit answer
suggested_action.verification_step: Re-run the audit and confirm the page no longer matches a known overlay signature

findings.title: 2 of 3 citable pages have no recognizable next step for the visitor

verification.method: re-fetched https://www.allbirds.com/pages/design-system with a different UA (GPTBot); status was None, now 200

findings.impact_mechanism: A visitor who arrives mid-task with their question already answered needs the next action available on the landing page itself -- requiring a navigation hunt to find it loses exactly the visitor this stage is scoped to, since they have no accumulated site context (unlike a browsing visitor) to know where to look.

suggested_action.summary: Add an explicit next-step action (contact, buy, sign up, demo) directly on the citable pages, not just in global nav.
implementation: Add a clear CTA near the end of the main content on each affected page
suggested_action.verification_step: Re-run the audit and confirm fewer pages appear in this finding's scope

proactive_recommendations.title: No page answers comparison-intent questions
proactive_recommendations.rationale: All 3 simulated comparison-intent queries came back unanswerable from the AI-reachable corpus (outcomes: partial, ungrounded). No defect was detected on any individual page -- the gap is that no page exists that would compare the brand against alternatives in a form retrieval can surface. An assistant asked this will cite whoever does have such a page, which is usually a competitor or an aggregator.

suggested_action.summary: Publish a page that directly answers comparison-intent questions in the buyer's own phrasing.
implementation: Review the comparison queries in the answerability matrix -- they are the literal phrasings to answer
State each answer directly in text, not only in marketing narrative or an image
Keep the subject and the fact in the same section so they land in the same retrieval chunk
suggested_action.verification_step: Re-run the audit and confirm at least one query in this intent class becomes 'answerable'

proactive_recommendations.title: No page answers trust-intent questions
proactive_recommendations.rationale: All 3 simulated trust-intent queries came back unanswerable from the AI-reachable corpus (outcomes: ungrounded). No defect was detected on any individual page -- the gap is that no page exists that would provide reviews, proof, or credibility signals in a form retrieval can surface. An assistant asked this will cite whoever does have such a page, which is usually a competitor or an aggregator.

suggested_action.summary: Publish a page that directly answers trust-intent questions in the buyer's own phrasing.
implementation: Review the trust queries in the answerability matrix -- they are the literal phrasings to answer
State each answer directly in text, not only in marketing narrative or an image
Keep the subject and the fact in the same section so they land in the same retrieval chunk
suggested_action.verification_step: Re-run the audit and confirm at least one query in this intent class becomes 'answerable'

proactive_recommendations.title: 5 queries are one edit away from being citable
proactive_recommendations.rationale: These queries resolved as PARTIAL: the facts needed are present in the corpus, but only by assembling them across chunks rather than from one self-contained passage. Real retrieval pipelines do this assembly unreliably, so a PARTIAL is fragile rather than safe. Because the content already exists, these are the lowest-effort upgrades available -- no new page required. Affected: [pricing] "What is the price of Allbirds's product?"; [comparison] 'What makes Allbirds different from other product options?'; [comparison] 'Is Allbirds better than alternatives?'; [capability] 'What features does Allbirds offer?'; [capability] "What are the specifications of Allbirds's product?"

suggested_action.summary: Co-locate each partially-answered fact into a single self-contained passage.
implementation: For each affected query, find where the facts currently live
Add one sentence or section that states the complete answer in one place
Name the subject explicitly in that passage -- do not rely on a heading several chunks earlier
suggested_action.verification_step: Re-run the audit and confirm these queries move from 'partial' to 'answerable'
